verify.VERIFIED: Checked against the embassy's official pages on {{date}}.
verify.PARTIAL: Mostly confirmed on {{date}}. Some details below are still being checked.

method.APPOINTMENT: book online, then go in person
method.CCVI: university gets a Certificate of Confirmation of Visa Issuance (CCVI), then you apply at the embassy

methodNote.WAITING_NUMBER: First collect a waiting number at the embassy gate; the embassy then posts the date you hand in your application.
methodNote.ONLINE_SLOTS: Book a slot online during the windows the embassy announces.
methodNote.INTAKE_WINDOWS: Student visas are taken only in set windows (spring: Dec 1–Feb 15, fall: Jun 1–Aug 14).
methodNote.ACCREDITED_ONLY: You can apply only through agencies the embassy has accredited. Check the embassy's list.
methodNote.KVAC_OR_AGENCIES: Apply in person at the visa application centre or at one of the agencies on the embassy's list.
methodNote.WALK_IN_TUE_THU: Students walk in on Tuesdays and Thursdays.
methodNote.EFORM_FIRST: Fill in the online e-Form on visa.go.kr first, then go to the embassy.
methodNote.OR_AGENCY: Apply in person or through an agency the embassy designates.
methodNote.G4K_BOOKING: Book online at g4k.go.kr, then go to the consulate in person. No one can apply for you.
methodNote.AGENCIES_ONLY_FROM_OCT: From 1 Oct 2026, this embassy or consulate takes applications only through its designated travel agencies.
methodNote.IN_PERSON_ONLY: Applications are taken in person only.

why.EVISA_TIER: {{university}} is certified for the e-visa, so the university applies for it for you. You don't need to visit the embassy.
why.CCVI_REQUIRED: For your nationality and this programme at {{university}}, the university must first get a Certificate of Confirmation of Visa Issuance (CCVI).
why.POST_BY_REGION: You live in the area that the Korean embassy or consulate in {{city}} covers, so you apply there.
why.POST_FOR_COUNTRY: Students living in {{country}} apply at the Korean embassy or consulate in {{city}}.
why.NO_EVISA_TIER: The e-visa isn't available for this degree at {{university}}'s certification level, so you apply at the embassy.
why.NO_EVISA_D41: Korean language programmes (D-4-1) have no e-visa, so you apply at the embassy.
why.CCVI_POSSIBLE: Your university may also apply for a Certificate of Confirmation of Visa Issuance (CCVI) for you. Your counselor tells you if it will.
why.rule: Apply where you live (or where you last studied), and only through the embassy's official channels.

caveat.ROUTE_PARTIAL: Some details for this route are not confirmed yet. The Hangyul team checks with the embassy before you apply.
caveat.LEGALIZATION_UNCLEAR: The embassy's list and the national visa manual differ on how your school documents must be authenticated: a translated copy or consular legalization. Your counselor confirms which one you need.
caveat.APOSTILLE_TRANSITION: Viet Nam started issuing apostilles on 11 Sep 2026, but the embassy's student visa lists still describe consular legalization. The Hangyul team confirms which one is accepted.
caveat.DIPLOMA_APOSTILLE_POSTS: The two offices differ. Astana requires an apostille on the diploma; Almaty says it is not mandatory. Your counselor confirms what your office needs.
caveat.APOSTILLE_WORDING_POSTS: The Mumbai checklist doesn't mention the apostille that Delhi and Chennai ask for. Your counselor confirms.
caveat.AMOUNTS_CONFLICT: Two official pages give different amounts for proof of funds. Your counselor confirms the current one.
caveat.TB_VALIDITY_CONFLICT: Official pages disagree on how long the TB certificate is valid (3 or 6 months). We use the stricter 3 months.
caveat.FEE_TIME_CONFLICT: Official pages disagree on the fee and processing time. Your counselor confirms them.
caveat.POST_SPLIT_UNVERIFIED: We couldn't confirm which regions the Manila and Cebu offices each cover. Your counselor tells you where to apply.
caveat.STALE_LIST: The embassy's document list is from 2019. Your counselor checks that it is still current.
caveat.FEE_EXEMPTION_UNCHECKED: We still need to check whether Thai nationals pay the visa fee. Your counselor confirms.
caveat.FUNDS_PERIOD_CONFLICT: The embassy and the national manual differ on how many months of funds language students must show. Your counselor confirms.
caveat.FEES_MISSING: The embassy doesn't publish the fee or processing time. Your counselor confirms them.
caveat.EVISA_TIER_UNKNOWN: If {{university}} holds the government's 'excellent' certification (or 'certified' for master's and doctoral study), the university can apply for an e-visa for you instead. We haven't confirmed its level. The Hangyul team checks.
caveat.CCVI_TIER_UNKNOWN: Depending on {{university}}'s certification level, the university may first need to apply for a Certificate of Confirmation of Visa Issuance (CCVI). Your counselor checks.
caveat.STALE_VERIFICATION: These rules were last checked on {{date}}. Your counselor checks them again before you apply.
caveat.POST_UNRESOLVED: We couldn't confirm which embassy or consulate covers your area. Your counselor tells you where to apply.
caveat.title: Details the Hangyul team confirms

state.NO_ROUTE: We haven't verified the rules for {{country}} yet. Your counselor confirms them.
state.NOT_VERIFIED: We haven't verified this route yet, so we don't show a checklist. Contact the embassy (link below) or ask your counselor.
state.OTHER_RESIDENCE: You live in {{country}}, so you usually apply at the Korean embassy or consulate there. We haven't verified that route. Your counselor confirms it.
state.IN_KOREA: You're already in Korea. You change your visa status at an immigration office, not at an embassy. Your counselor guides you.
state.NEEDS_PROFILE: Add your nationality to your profile so we can find your embassy's rules.
state.NEEDS_PROGRAM: Choose a programme first. The visa type depends on what you study.
state.fallbackTitle: General checklist (not verified for your country)

question.residence_region: Which area do you live in?
question.why: Each embassy or consulate accepts students only from the area it covers. This decides where you apply.
question.unsure: Not sure? Ask the Hangyul team.

docs.title: Your visa documents
docs.previewSub: From the embassy's list for your nationality. The full plan opens once your university issues your admission letter.
docs.maybeSub: The Hangyul team confirms whether these apply to you.
docs.validity: Must be issued within {{days}} days before you apply

docStatus.NEW_FOR_VISA: New one required for the visa
docStatus.FORM: Prepare it with the form below

reason.RECEIVED: You told us you have it from the university.
reason.NEEDS_LEGALIZATION: It needs confirmation for use abroad before the embassy accepts it.
reason.EXPIRED: It has expired. You need a newly issued copy.
reason.NEW_FOR_VISA: The embassy needs one issued within {{days}} days before you apply.
reason.GET_LATER: Don't get it yet. Get it on or after {{date}} so it's still valid on {{appointment}}.
reason.WAITING_UNIVERSITY: {{university}} sends this. Nothing to do until it arrives.
reason.VISA_ONLY: Only the visa needs this. It isn't in your documents yet.
reason.FORM: You prepare it with the form below; you fill in and sign the official form yourself.
reason.TB_AT_REGISTRATION: With the e-visa, you submit the TB certificate when you register as a foreign resident in Korea.
reason.NEAR_EXPIRY_DATE: Expires on {{date}}. Renew it before you apply.
reason.PASSPORT_VALIDITY: Your passport expires on {{date}}. Many embassies ask for at least 6 months of validity.

cond.PARENT_SPONSOR: Needed because your parents pay for your studies.
cond.SCHOLARSHIP: Only if you have a scholarship.
cond.ADULT: For first-time applicants aged 18 or older.
cond.EXCELLENT_WAIVER: Needed unless your university has the 'excellent' certification.
cond.LOWER_TIER: Only for some universities. Your counselor confirms.
cond.AGENCY_ONLY: Only if an agency hands in the application for you.
cond.POST_SPECIFIC: Only some embassies or consulates ask for this. It depends on where you apply.
cond.OTHER: Only in some cases. The Hangyul team confirms.

application_form.name: Visa application form
application_form.why: The embassy's own form, with your photo.

photo.name: Passport photo
photo.why: A recent photo that matches you today.

passport.name: Passport
passport.why: The visa goes into it; it must stay valid long enough.

final_education_certificate.name: Graduation certificate
final_education_certificate.why: Proves your last completed school level, confirmed for use abroad.

tb_test.name: Tuberculosis (TB) test certificate
tb_test.why: Required for your nationality for stays over 90 days. Get it from a clinic the embassy designates.

bank_balance_certificate.name: Bank balance certificate
bank_balance_certificate.why: Shows you can pay for your studies and living costs.

business_registration.name: University's business registration certificate
business_registration.why: The university's business registration. It comes with your admission papers.

family_relation_certificate.name: Family relationship certificate
family_relation_certificate.why: Links you to the parents whose money you show.

sponsor_documents.name: Sponsor's financial documents
sponsor_documents.why: ID and proof of income or employment for the person paying your costs.

language_certificate.name: Language test certificate
language_certificate.why: Some universities and embassies ask for TOPIK or IELTS.

other_scholarship_certificate.name: Scholarship confirmation from the university
other_scholarship_certificate.why: Shows a scholarship covers part of your costs.

transcript.name: Transcript
transcript.why: Your grades, confirmed for use abroad.

other_cover_letter.name: Cover letter for your visa request
other_cover_letter.why: A short letter explaining your study plan.

other_training_plan.name: Training program plan (from the institution)
other_training_plan.why: What you will study during the language programme.

other_self_intro_study_plan.name: Handwritten self-introduction and study plan
other_self_intro_study_plan.why: Who you are and what you plan to study.

other_marital_status.name: Marital status documents
other_marital_status.why: The embassy asks for it on its list.

criminal_record.name: Criminal record certificate
criminal_record.why: Shows you have no criminal record. Issued by the police.

other_bank_statement.name: Bank statement for the last 6 months (original)

other_address_certificate.name: Address certificate (screenshot from your e-government account)
other_address_certificate.why: Proves where you live, which decides where you apply.

other_study_plan.name: Study plan
other_study_plan.why: What you plan to study and why.

other_agency_documents.name: Your study agency's business registration, representative's ID copy and contacts
other_agency_documents.why: Only when an accredited agency hands in your application.

other_nrc.name: NRC card (original, copy and notarised English translation)
other_nrc.why: Your national ID card, with a translation.

other_id_copy.name: Copy of your national ID card (front and back)
other_id_copy.why: A copy of your national ID card.

other_applicant_questionnaire.name: Embassy questionnaire for study visa applicants
other_applicant_questionnaire.why: The embassy's questions about your plans.

other_minor_consent.name: Parents' or guardian's consent to travel, with ID
other_minor_consent.why: Needed when a minor applies alone.

other_occupation_proof.name: Proof of occupation (employment or student certificate)

other_income_tax_return.name: Income tax returns (2 years; 3 for a business)
other_income_tax_return.why: Shows your sponsor's income over time.

other_health_condition_report.name: Health condition report
other_health_condition_report.why: A health form some embassies and consulates ask for.

other_declaration_form.name: Declaration form
other_declaration_form.why: The embassy's or consulate's own form. You sign it yourself.

other_tuition_payment_certificate.name: University payment certificate
other_tuition_payment_certificate.why: From the university, once you have paid.

other_birth_certificate.name: Birth certificate (original and copy)
other_birth_certificate.why: Proves your date of birth and parents.

other_parents_noc.name: Parents' no-objection letter with their ID copies
other_parents_noc.why: Your parents agree to your study abroad.

other_air_ticket_booking.name: Flight booking
other_air_ticket_booking.why: A booking, not a paid ticket. Some embassies ask for it.

other_polio_vaccination.name: Polio vaccination certificate
other_polio_vaccination.why: Asked for by the Karachi office.

other_passport_record.name: Passport issuance record (from the Ministry of Foreign Affairs)

other_travel_history.name: Visas and entry stamps to OECD countries (last 5 years)
other_travel_history.why: Previous visas and trips, if any.

other_exchange_agreement.name: Scholarship or exchange agreement and your school's recommendation

generic.why: The embassy lists it for students from your country.

timing.getAfter: Get it on or after {{date}} so it's still valid on {{appointment}}.
timing.nowOk: Any copy issued from today is still valid on {{appointment}}.
timing.noDate: Must be issued within {{days}} days before you apply. Choose your application date first, then get it.

money.title: Proof of funds
money.none: The embassy doesn't state an amount. Your counselor confirms what to show.
money.never: Never use borrowed money, or money lent by an agency, for the bank balance certificate. The embassy checks for this, and it can lead to refusal.

choose_post.title: Tell us where you live
choose_post.why: It decides which embassy or consulate takes your application.

slow_items.title: Start the slowest documents first
slow_items.why: Apostilles or consular legalization, the TB test and police certificates can take weeks.

university_papers.title: Documents from your university
university_papers.why: The admission letter and business registration certificate come from the university.

documents.title: Reuse and add documents
documents.why: We reuse what you already have. Add only what is new for the visa.

form.title: Check your form details
form.why: So the official form you fill in matches your documents.

university_files_evisa.title: Your university files the e-visa
university_files_evisa.why: Give the university your documents; it applies on visa.go.kr.

university_files_ccvi.title: Your university gets the issuance certificate
university_files_ccvi.why: Required first for your nationality and programme.

book.title: Book your application date
book.why: Book through the embassy's official system only.

fresh_items.title: Get time-limited documents last
fresh_items.why: So they are still valid on your application day.

apply.title: Apply and record the receipt
apply.why: Submit your documents, then enter the receipt number here.

decision.title: Decision
decision.why: The embassy decides; you record the result here.

form.title: Prepare your visa form
form.notice: For your preparation only. You'll fill in and sign the official form yourself (or your university applies for the e-visa). Hangyul never submits or declares anything for you.
form.correctedHint: You changed this here only. If it's wrong in your profile, update it there too.
form.missingHint: We don't have this. You'll write it on the official form.

source.official_form: Write it on the official form

track.title: Apply and track
track.appointmentHint: Book it through the embassy's official system, then note the date here. We check that your documents are still valid on that day.
track.handoffText: You'll book on the embassy's official page. Your plan stays here, so come back and note the date and your receipt number.
track.handoffOpened: You opened the official page on {{date}}.
track.submitText: After you hand in your application, note the date and the receipt number the embassy or centre gave you (or upload the receipt).
track.needEvidence: Add the receipt number or upload the receipt.
track.waitingText: The embassy decides. Processing time (embassy's wording) is below; we'll remind you to record the result.
track.requestAdd: The embassy asked me for something
track.issuedText: Upload your visa (or the e-visa grant notice). Then you can start your arrival plan.
track.issuedDone: Visa issued on {{date}}. Plan your arrival next.

help.title: Need help with your visa?

REFUSED.needed: Your counselor reads the refusal reason with you and plans the next step (some embassies set a waiting time before you can apply again).

EMBASSY_REQUEST.what: The embassy asked for something more.
EMBASSY_REQUEST.needed: Send exactly what they asked for by the date; your counselor has been told and checks it with you.

NO_ROUTE.what: We don't have verified rules for your country yet.
NO_ROUTE.needed: Your counselor confirms the embassy's current list with you.

NOT_VERIFIED.needed: Your counselor confirms the list with the embassy.

OTHER_RESIDENCE.what: You live outside your home country.
OTHER_RESIDENCE.needed: Your counselor checks whether the Korean embassy or consulate where you live accepts your application.

IN_KOREA.needed: A change of status goes through the immigration office. Your counselor guides you.

NEEDS_ANSWER.what: We need to know where you live.
NEEDS_ANSWER.needed: Answer the question above and we'll tell you which embassy or consulate to apply to.

help.askHint: Your question goes to the Hangyul team and its visa specialists.
help.sent: Sent. Your counselor will reply in Messages.
help.open: Your question is with the team

disclaimer: Visas are issued by the Korean government (embassy, consulate or immigration). Hangyul helps you prepare; it does not issue visas.
